about: HeartGold/SoulSilver story steps for the guide panel's NEXT section, written by hand for this site. Each todo line is [text, condition, place]; place (optional) is where it happens: a map id (hgss.json), [map id, x, z] for a spot on it, or "HG id|SS id". Clicking the bullet shows the way there. Conditions are read from the save data in DS RAM: f:N event flag (fly-point flags 0x9B0+ mark towns visited), t:N trainer beaten, b:N Johto badge bit, k:N Kanto badge bit, v:VAR>=N story variable (hex id); | is any, & is all (binds tighter). An empty condition is shown as a plain bullet. A step also counts as done once any later step is done, unless it is free (Kanto gyms: any order). Text in {HeartGold|SoulSilver} picks the version. Boss teams and catch sprites come from bosses.json (tools/story_data.py); a Rival with t: [a, b, c] is picked by the player's starter (Chikorita, Cyndaquil, Totodile). types/weak are type names shown as icons. "opt" lists optional side quests worth doing at that point, with the same kind of conditions; c:N is National Dex N caught (Pokédex in the save).

steps.title: Get your first Pokémon
todo: Go next door to Prof. Elm's Lab and pick a starter
Cyndaquil is the easiest start; Chikorita is the hard mode

steps.title: Run Elm's errand to Mr. Pokémon
todo: Walk west on Route 29 to Cherrygrove City
Let the old man show you around town (Map card)
Go north on Route 30 to Mr. Pokémon's house
Get the Mystery Egg, and the Pokédex from Prof. Oak
opt: Mystic Water from the man by the water in Cherrygrove (boosts Water moves)

steps.title: Beat your rival in Cherrygrove
todo: Take Elm's panic call and head back south
Beat the red-haired rival in Cherrygrove
Train your starter to level 7-8 first

steps.title: Report back to Prof. Elm
todo: Walk back east to New Bark Town
Tell the police officer the thief's name
Hand Elm the Egg and hear what's next

steps.title: Head to Violet City and climb Sprout Tower
todo: Catching lesson on Route 29 (5 Poké Balls)
Go north via Routes 30 and 31 to Violet City
Climb Sprout Tower and beat Elder Li (TM70 Flash)
opt: Trade a Bellsprout for an Onix in Violet City
Ruins of Alph (west of Route 32): solve the Kabuto puzzle
Unown Report from the Ruins of Alph research center

steps.title: Gym 1: Falkner
todo: Beat Falkner: Zephyr Badge and TM51 Roost
Aim for level 12-14; Rock or Electric types make it easy

steps.title: Collect the Egg from Elm's aide
todo: Answer Elm's call and visit the Violet Poké Mart
Keep the Egg in your party: it hatches into Togepi

steps.title: Go south to Azalea Town
todo: Get the Old Rod in the Route 32 Pokémon Center
Chase Team Rocket out of Slowpoke Well, beat Proton
opt: TM05 Roar from a man on Route 32
Lure Ball from Kurt's fan on Route 32

steps.title: Gym 2: Bugsy
todo: Beat Bugsy: Hive Badge and TM89 U-turn
opt: Apricorn Box from the Route 30 Apricorn House: Kurt turns Apricorns into special Poké Balls
King's Rock from the man in Slowpoke Well

steps.title: Rival battle at the Azalea exit
todo: Walk west toward Ilex Forest and beat the rival
Normal and Fighting moves can't hit his Gastly

steps.title: Ilex Forest: herd the Farfetch'd, get Cut
todo: Find the first lost Farfetch'd and scare it home
Get HM01 Cut from the charcoal man
Cut the tree blocking the north exit
opt: Charcoal from the charcoal kiln in Azalea (boosts Fire moves)
TM12 Taunt from the woman in the north Ilex Forest gate

steps.title: Gym 3: Whitney
todo: Go north on Route 34 to Goldenrod City
Beat Whitney (talk to her again if she cries)
Use Fighting moves; female Pokémon dodge Attract
opt: Free Bicycle from the Bike Shop
Radio Card from the Radio Tower 1F quiz
Eevee from Bill at his house
Trade a Drowzee for Machop (Dept. Store 5F)
Pokéathlon Dome, north of Goldenrod on Route 35

steps.title: Water the odd tree on Route 36
todo: Get the SquirtBottle at the Goldenrod Flower Shop
Go north on Route 35, then east on Route 36
Water the odd tree: Sudowoodo battle (level 20)
Get HM06 Rock Smash from the man nearby
opt: Bug-Catching Contest in National Park (Tue, Thu, Sat): prizes include stones
Quick Claw from the woman in National Park

steps.title: Ecruteak: the Burned Tower
todo: Go north on Route 37 to Ecruteak City
Try the Gym: Morty is out at the Burned Tower
Beat the rival in the Burned Tower
Drop to the basement and wake the legendary beasts

steps.title: Gym 4: Morty
todo: Beat Morty: Fog Badge and TM30 Shadow Ball
Walk the hidden path; bring Awakenings, level 25+

steps.title: Win Surf at the Dance Theater
todo: Beat the Rocket grunt bothering a Kimono Girl
Get HM03 Surf from the gentleman

steps.title: Olivine City, then surf to Cianwood
todo: Go west on Routes 38-39 to Olivine City
Meet Jasmine at the top of the Lighthouse
Surf west across Routes 40-41 to Cianwood City
Beat Chuck: Storm Badge and TM01 Focus Punch
opt: Good Rod from the fisherman in Olivine
Trade a Krabby for a Voltorb in Olivine
Nurse the sick Miltank at MooMoo Farm (Route 39): TM83 and cheap Moomoo Milk
Catch Lapras in Union Cave B2F (Fridays, needs Surf)

steps.title: Get the medicine (and Fly)
todo: Get HM02 Fly from Chuck's wife
Get the SecretPotion at the Pharmacy

steps.title: Gym 5: Jasmine
todo: Give the SecretPotion to Amphy at the Lighthouse top
Beat Jasmine: Mineral Badge and TM23 Iron Tail

steps.title: Lake of Rage and the red Gyarados
todo: Get HM04 Strength from the man on Route 42
Go east on Route 42 to Mahogany Town
Go north on Route 43 to the Lake of Rage
Battle the red Gyarados (level 30) for the Red Scale
opt: Trade the Red Scale for an Exp. Share at Mr. Pokémon's house
TM10 Hidden Power from the man at Lake of Rage
Black Belt from Wesley at Lake of Rage (Wednesdays)

steps.title: Raid the Team Rocket hideout
todo: Go under the Mahogany souvenir shop with Lance

steps.title: Gym 6: Pryce
todo: Beat Pryce: Glacier Badge and TM07 Hail

steps.title: Free the Radio Tower
todo: Fight up the Goldenrod Radio Tower
Beat Petrel on 5F for the Basement Key
Beat the rival in the Goldenrod Tunnel
Free the Director in the warehouse (Card Key)
Beat Archer on the Observation Deck

steps.title: Ice Path to Blackthorn and Clair
todo: Go east on Route 44 into the Ice Path
Level 38-40; bring Ice moves and Paralyze Heals

steps.title: Pass Clair's test in the Dragon's Den
todo: Surf to the shrine in the Dragon's Den
Answer the Dragon Master kindly: Rising Badge
opt: All kind answers earn a Dratini with ExtremeSpeed

steps.title: Elm's Master Ball
todo: Fly to New Bark and get the Master Ball from Elm

steps.title: The Kimono Girls and {Ho-Oh|Lugia}
todo: Beat the five Kimono Girls at the Dance Theater
Meet {Ho-Oh at the Bell Tower top|Lugia deep in the Whirl Islands}
Save first: it's level 45, one chance

steps.title: The Pokémon League
todo: Surf east from New Bark to Route 27
Show your badges at the Route 26 gate
Beat the rival in Victory Road
Reach Indigo Plateau and stock up

steps.title: Sail to Kanto
todo: Get the S.S. Ticket from Elm
Ride the S.S. Aqua from Olivine to Vermilion
opt: Rare Candy from the Fan Club chairman in Vermilion
PP Max from a man in Vermilion

steps.title: Kanto gym: Lt. Surge
todo: Kanto gyms work in any order
Solve the trash-can switches and beat Lt. Surge

steps.title: Fix the Power Plant
todo: Hear the manager's story at the Route 10 Power Plant
Find the stolen part in the Cerulean Gym
Bring it back to the manager
Get the EXPN Card at the Lavender Radio Tower
Play the Poké Flute channel to wake Snorlax
opt: Catch Snorlax on Route 11 (Poké Flute channel on the Pokégear)

steps.title: Kanto gym: Janine
todo: Find the real Janine and beat her

steps.title: Kanto gym: Blaine
todo: Beat Blaine in the Seafoam Islands

steps.title: Kanto gym: Blue
todo: Beat Blue in Viridian City (after the other 7)

steps.title: Mt. Silver: the final battle
todo: Talk to Prof. Oak in Pallet Town
Take Routes 22 and 28 to Mt. Silver
Beat the trainer at the summit

steps.title: You've beaten the story!
opt: Get a Kanto starter from Prof. Oak
